misconceptions.wrong: High temperature gives the best yield.
misconceptions.right: The forward reaction is exothermic — high temp lowers yield.

misconceptions.wrong: Conditions are chosen for maximum yield.
misconceptions.right: They are a compromise of yield, rate and cost.
